changes: Added to notes: the era is written only as 'saṃ'; NS is inferred from the Newari script and from the catalogue's king Jitamitra Malla (Bhaktapur, r. c. 1673–1696), which fits NS 807 = 1687 CE
Added to notes: the colophon reads the title as 'bhārdīśa', not 'bhāratīsammata'

notes: The era is written only as 'saṃ 807'. NS is inferred from the Newari script and from the catalogue's king Jitamitra Malla of Bhaktapur (r. c. 1673–1696). NS 807 = c. 1687 CE fits his reign. The catalogue names Jitamitra Malla, but the quoted colophon names no persons, so he is not recorded here. The title as written is 'madālasāharaṇa bhārdīśanāmanāṭakaṃ', which may be a corruption of 'bhāratī...'. It differs from the catalogue title 'Madālasāharaṇabhāratīsammatanāṭaka'.
